description: This file defines the SavedNewsScreen widget in a Flutter application, which displays a list of saved news articles, allows opening individual articles, and supports deleting saved articles with confirmation.

classes.name: SavedNewsScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the screen that displays saved news articles to the user, with functionality to view or delete articles.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for displaying saved news, either as a message for no saved news or a list of saved articles.

methods.name: _open
methods.description: Navigates to the read article screen for the selected news article.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog to delete a news article and deletes it if confirmed, then shows a snackbar notification.
